pages.mainText: VitaDairy Nghĩa vụ vun bồi sức sống Khởi đầu bằng sự TỬ TẾ, kết hợp với tính KHOA HỌC cùng sự SÁNG TẠO không ngừng nghỉ, VitaDairy lấy 3 yếu tố đó làm giá trị cốt lõi để truyền cảm hứng và lan tỏa tinh thần VÌ CON NGƯỜI đến với tập thể cán bộ nhân viên. VitaDairy được thành lập với mục tiêu vì con người, mang theo sứ mệnh Vun bồi sức sống và luôn nỗ lực hết mình để cống hiến cho lợi ích chung của xã hội. This was the motivation and a great inspiration for Dr. Tu Anh to start a business so that she could develop good nutritional products, initially for patients.VitaDairy was born from that passion!

Vitadairy Vietnam Joint Stock Company is a Vietnam-based nutrition and dairy company specializing in research-driven powdered milk and specialized nutrition products. The company develops, manufactures through partner facilities, and markets a broad portfolio of nutritional formulations for multiple age and health segments. Its product lines cover infant formula and young-child nutrition, maternal nutrition for pregnant and lactating women, adult and elderly nutritional milk, and medical or condition-specific nutrition products designed to support recovery, weight management, immunity, and metabolic health. Vitadairy's brands are positioned in the premium and functional nutrition space, with formulations emphasizing clinically informed ingredients, micronutrient optimization, and suitability for Vietnamese dietary needs. The company maintains nationwide distribution through pharmacies, modern retail, mother-and-baby stores, hospitals and clinics, and e-commerce. Key assets include its in-house nutrition R&D capability, a diversified brand and SKU portfolio, strong channel partnerships in pharmacy and healthcare retail, and marketing systems that leverage medical and nutritionist engagement. Strategic focus centers on expanding leadership in specialized nutrition, strengthening scientific credibility, continuously innovating functional formulations, growing omnichannel penetration, and positioning Vitadairy as a trusted domestic nutrition brand aligned with Vietnam's rising health awareness and premium dairy consumption trends.

searchResults.highlight: VitaDairy, founded in 2005, is one of the leading dairy nutrition manufacturers in Vietnam. We specialize in infant formula, follow-on formula, and growing-up formula, and we are recognized as one of the Top 2 baby formula brands in Vietnam. Our portfolio also includes nutritional products for adults and the elderly, such as high-calorie formulas and plant-based protein solutions, as well as specialized medical nutrition designed for diabetes care, renal support, and hepatic management. Our production facilities operate in strict compliance with ISO, HACCP, and GMP standards. We are fully certified Halal across various product categories, ensuring suitability for Muslim-majority markets. In addition, we possess strong R&D capabilities and extensive experience in developing customized products for international markets. With a commitment to quality, innovation, and global partnership, VitaDairy continues to deliver trusted nutritional solutions to consumers worldwide.
